The Yoga Garden

A studio that feels like itself.

The Yoga Garden is a bright little studio in Greenwood with yoga, Pilates, heated classes, strength-based movement, and a whole lot of plants. Mats and props are there when you need them. Classes are small enough to know who’s in the room. And the garden keeps changing as baby plants grow, head out into the community, and make space for the next ones.

The Garden

The plants are not decoration.

Genevieve’s indoor garden grows right inside the studio. Baby plants are tucked throughout the space, and when they’re ready for a new home, they can head out into the community and make room for another one to grow.

If you have a plant that needs a new home, there’s room for that too.

My Garden

Booking should be the easy part.

Set up your details once and sign the studio consent form. After that, pick a class, choose cash or e-transfer, and you’re booked. If plans change, cancel from your account and the open spot can move to the next person waiting.

  • See upcoming bookings
  • Cancel when you can’t make it
  • Join a cancellation list
  • Keep your details and consent form together
